blocks.zh: 藥品相容性 - 上半部 (14.0 ~ 14.3)
blocks.en: Drug Product Compatibility - Part 1 (14.0 to 14.3)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives of This Chapter

blocks.zh: 瞭解藥品與預填充式注射器各組件之間的相容性評估框架
blocks.en: Understand the framework for assessing compatibility between the drug product and each component of the prefilled syringe

blocks.zh: 掌握如何運用 FMEA 進行風險評估，判定製程參數的關鍵性
blocks.en: Learn how to use FMEA for risk assessment to determine the criticality of process parameters

blocks.zh: 熟悉穩定性試驗的設計要點，包括長期、加速及應力條件
blocks.en: Become familiar with the key points in designing stability studies, including long-term, accelerated and stress conditions

blocks.zh: 理解注射力量量測與矽油對分析測試的影響
blocks.en: Understand the measurement of syringe forces and the effect of silicone oil on analytical testing

blocks.zh: 認識藥品與活塞膠塞/護針蓋之間相互作用的風險與評估策略
blocks.en: Recognize the risks and assessment strategies for interactions between the drug product and the plunger stopper/needle shield

blocks.zh: 14.0 Drug Product Compatibility 14.0 藥品相容性
blocks.en: 14.0 Drug Product Compatibility

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析
blocks.en: Core Concepts

blocks.zh: Drug Product Compatibility (藥品相容性)：指藥品與預填充式注射器 (PFS) 各組件（玻璃管壁、矽油塗層、膠塞、護針蓋、針頭等）之間是否能「和平共處」，不會因接觸而造成藥品降解、聚集或效力損失。
blocks.en: Drug Product Compatibility: whether the drug product can "coexist peacefully" with each component of the prefilled syringe (PFS) (glass barrel, silicone oil coating, stopper, needle shield, needle, etc.), so that contact does not cause degradation, aggregation or loss of potency.

blocks.zh: 本章是 TR73 的整合性章節，前面各章分別討論了個別組件的特性，此處則從藥品的角度，全面檢視這些組件在製造、運輸、儲存及使用過程中對產品的影響。
blocks.en: This chapter of TR73 is an integrating chapter. The earlier chapters discussed the characteristics of individual components; here the components are reviewed as a whole from the drug product perspective, looking at their effect on the product during manufacturing, transport, storage and use.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你要將一瓶高級紅酒倒入不同材質的容器中儲存——玻璃瓶、塑膠杯、金屬壺、軟木塞或螺旋蓋。每種材質都可能改變酒的風味、色澤甚至安全性。藥品相容性測試就像「品酒師」逐一測試每種容器，確保藥品在最終包裝中的品質不受影響。
blocks.en: Imagine pouring a bottle of fine red wine into different containers for storage: a glass bottle, a plastic cup, a metal jug, a cork or a screw cap. Each material could change the wine's flavor, color or even safety. Drug compatibility testing is like a "sommelier" tasting the wine from each container one by one, to make sure the quality of the drug product in its final packaging is not affected.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Point

blocks.zh: 生物製劑（蛋白質藥品）對界面和應力特別敏感。蛋白質可能在氣-液界面、矽油-液體界面發生吸附與變性，因此 PFS 的相容性評估比傳統小分子藥品更為關鍵。
blocks.en: Biologics (protein drugs) are particularly sensitive to interfaces and stress. Proteins may adsorb and denature at the air-liquid interface and the silicone oil-liquid interface, so PFS compatibility assessment is more critical than for conventional small-molecule drugs.

blocks.zh: 14.1 Risk Assessment 14.1 風險評估
blocks.en: 14.1 Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis，失效模式與效應分析)：是品質風險管理 (QRM) 中最常用的工具之一。透過系統性地列出每一個製程步驟可能出現的失效模式，評估其嚴重度 (Severity)、發生機率 (Occurrence) 及可偵測性 (Detection)，計算出風險優先指數 (RPN)，據此決定緩解策略。
blocks.en: FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): one of the most commonly used tools in quality risk management (QRM). It systematically lists the possible failure modes of each process step, assesses their severity (Severity), likelihood of occurrence (Occurrence) and detectability (Detection), and calculates a risk priority number (RPN), which is then used to decide on mitigation strategies.

blocks.zh: Criticality（關鍵性）：風險評估將每項參數分為 High / Medium / Low 三個等級。High 代表必須立即採取行動，Medium 需要監控與研究，Low 可透過常規管控處理。
blocks.en: Criticality: the risk assessment classifies each parameter as High, Medium or Low. High means action must be taken immediately, Medium needs monitoring and study, and Low can be handled through routine controls.

blocks.zh: FMEA 就像在搬家前逐一檢查每件家具——這張桌子搬下樓梯會不會卡住？（嚴重度高）這個花瓶在卡車上會不會摔破？（發生機率高）我能不能在到達新家後馬上發現損壞？（可偵測性）。根據這三個維度，你決定哪些物品需要特殊保護、哪些可以正常搬運。
blocks.en: FMEA is like checking each piece of furniture before a house move: will this table get stuck going down the stairs? (high severity) Will this vase break on the truck? (high occurrence) Will I be able to spot the damage right after arriving at the new home? (detectability) Based on these three dimensions, you decide which items need special protection and which can be moved as usual.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：跨部門協作
blocks.en: Key Point: Cross-Functional Collaboration

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調風險評估必須由 R&D 和製造部門共同參與。這是因為：
blocks.en: The original text specifically stresses that the risk assessment must involve both R&D and manufacturing. The reasons are:

blocks.zh: R&D 最了解蛋白質的分子特性與已知降解途徑
blocks.en: R&D knows the most about the molecular properties of the protein and its known degradation pathways

blocks.zh: 製造部門 最了解實際製程中會遇到的應力條件（剪切力、溫度、接觸時間等）
blocks.en: Manufacturing knows the most about the stress conditions (shear, temperature, contact time, etc.) actually encountered in the process

blocks.zh: 兩者缺一，風險評估就會有盲點。
blocks.en: Without both, the risk assessment will have blind spots.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀：Table 14.1-1
blocks.en: Reading the Table: Table 14.1-1

blocks.zh: 此表是 FMEA 輸出的範例。值得注意的幾個高風險項目：
blocks.en: This table is an example of FMEA output. Several high-risk items are worth noting:

blocks.zh: 過濾器相容性（High）：不適合的過濾器可能吸附蛋白質或釋出浸出物，直接影響產品品質
blocks.en: Filter compatibility (High): an unsuitable filter may adsorb protein or release leachables, directly affecting product quality

blocks.zh: 殘留 VHP 濃度（High）：氣化過氧化氫 (VHP) 用於設備除污，但殘留物可氧化蛋白質，造成效力降低
blocks.en: Residual VHP concentration (High): vaporized hydrogen peroxide (VHP) is used for equipment decontamination, but residues can oxidize proteins and reduce potency

blocks.zh: 充填速度（Medium）：過快的充填速度會產生過大的剪切力 (Shear)，可能導致蛋白質聚集
blocks.en: Filling speed (Medium): an excessive filling speed generates excessive shear, which may cause protein aggregation

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Questions to Consider

blocks.zh: 如果你的蛋白質藥品對氧化特別敏感，在 FMEA 中你會特別關注表中哪些製程步驟？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your protein drug is particularly sensitive to oxidation, which process steps in the table would you pay special attention to in the FMEA, and why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「充填速度」被歸類為 Medium 而非 High？在什麼情況下它可能升級為 High？
blocks.en: Why is "filling speed" classified as Medium rather than High? Under what circumstances might it be upgraded to High?

blocks.zh: FMEA 完成後需要「reevaluated and rescored」，這反映了品質風險管理的什麼核心原則？
blocks.en: After the FMEA is completed it must be "reevaluated and rescored". What core principle of quality risk management does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 14.2 Key Product and Manufacturing Attributes 14.2 關鍵產品與製造屬性
blocks.en: 14.2 Key Product and Manufacturing Attributes

blocks.zh: 14.2.1 Stability Studies 14.2.1 穩定性研究
blocks.en: 14.2.1 Stability Studies

blocks.zh: Stability Studies（穩定性試驗）：是確認藥品在 PFS 中整個貨架期內維持品質的核心證據。ICH Q1A(R2) 定義了三個層次的儲存條件：
blocks.en: Stability Studies: the core evidence confirming that the drug product maintains its quality in the PFS throughout its shelf life. ICH Q1A(R2) defines three levels of storage conditions:

blocks.zh: Long-term（長期）：推薦儲存條件（如 2-8°C），測試至預期的貨架期
blocks.en: Long-term: the recommended storage condition (e.g., 2-8°C), tested through to the intended shelf life

blocks.zh: Accelerated（加速）：升高溫度（如 25°C），評估短期溫度偏移的影響
blocks.en: Accelerated: an elevated temperature (e.g., 25°C), to assess the effect of short-term temperature excursions

blocks.zh: Stress（應力）：更極端條件（如 40°C），用於瞭解降解途徑和機制
blocks.en: Stress: more extreme conditions (e.g., 40°C), used to understand degradation pathways and mechanisms

blocks.zh: 對蛋白質藥品而言，選擇應力溫度時必須考慮蛋白質的 melting temperature (Tm，熔解溫度)，避免因溫度過高導致不可逆變性，使試驗結果失去意義。
blocks.en: For protein drugs, the melting temperature (Tm) of the protein must be considered when selecting the stress temperature, to avoid irreversible denaturation from excessive temperature, which would make the study results meaningless.

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗就像「食品保存期限測試」。你把優格放在冰箱（長期）、室溫（加速）和烈日下（應力）分別存放，定期品嚐和檢驗，以確定在什麼條件下、多久之後會變質。不同的是，藥品穩定性試驗還必須確保容器本身（注射器）不會「污染」內容物。
blocks.en: A stability study is like a "food shelf-life test". You keep yogurt in the refrigerator (long-term), at room temperature (accelerated) and in the hot sun (stress), then taste and inspect it at regular intervals to determine under what conditions, and after how long, it spoils. The difference is that a drug stability study must also make sure the container itself (the syringe) does not "contaminate" the contents.

blocks.zh: 表格解讀：Table 14.2.1-1
blocks.en: Reading the Table: Table 14.2.1-1

blocks.zh: 這張表列出了 PFS 穩定性評估的九大試驗類型，是建立穩定性方案的檢查清單。幾個重要觀察：
blocks.en: This table lists the nine test types for PFS stability assessment and serves as a checklist for building a stability protocol. A few important observations:

blocks.zh: Comparability（可比較性）：如果藥品已有西林瓶 (vial) 的穩定性數據，可以藉此「借力」加速 PFS 的貨架期設定——這對 CDMO 來說是縮短時程的策略
blocks.en: Comparability: if stability data already exist for the drug in a vial, they can be used to "borrow strength" and speed up setting the PFS shelf life. For a CDMO this is a strategy for shortening timelines

blocks.zh: Shear（剪切力）：特別提醒實驗室桌面測試 (benchtop) 與商業製程的剪切力可能不同，意味著小規模結果不一定直接適用於量產
blocks.en: Shear: a specific reminder that shear in laboratory benchtop tests may differ from that in the commercial process, meaning small-scale results do not necessarily apply directly to full-scale production

blocks.zh: Device Stability：如果 PFS 要搭配自動注射器 (autoinjector) 使用，則需連同裝置一起做穩定性測試
blocks.en: Device Stability: if the PFS will be used with an autoinjector, stability testing must be performed together with the device

blocks.zh: 實務應用
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，當客戶帶著新蛋白質藥品來討論 PFS 專案時，你應該在早期就建議客戶提供以下資訊以規劃穩定性方案：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when a client comes to discuss a PFS project for a new protein drug, you should recommend early on that the client provide the following information so the stability program can be planned:

blocks.zh: 蛋白質的 Tm（熔解溫度）——決定應力測試溫度的選擇
blocks.en: The Tm (melting temperature) of the protein, which determines the choice of stress test temperature

blocks.zh: 是否有已知的矽油或鎢敏感性——決定 PFS 規格選擇
blocks.en: Any known sensitivity to silicone oil or tungsten, which determines the choice of PFS specification

blocks.zh: 是否有西林瓶穩定性數據——可做 comparability 評估
blocks.en: Whether vial stability data are available, which allows a comparability assessment

blocks.zh: 最終是否搭配注射裝置——影響穩定性方案的範疇
blocks.en: Whether the product will ultimately be combined with an injection device, which affects the scope of the stability program

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Table 14.2.1-1 中的「Long-Term Stability」特別提到要包含臨床試驗使用的充填體積？這與 bracketing approach 有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does Table 14.2.1-1 specifically state that "Long-Term Stability" should include the fill volumes used in clinical trials? How does this relate to the bracketing approach?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶的蛋白質 Tm 為 55°C，你會建議加速試驗溫度設定為多少？為什麼不建議用 40°C 作為應力條件？
blocks.en: If the client's protein has a Tm of 55°C, what accelerated test temperature would you recommend? Why would you not recommend 40°C as the stress condition?

blocks.zh: 14.2.2 Analysis of Stability 14.2.2 穩定性分析
blocks.en: 14.2.2 Analysis of Stability

blocks.zh: 穩定性分析涵蓋三大類檢測：
blocks.en: Stability analysis covers three categories of testing:

blocks.zh: Physical（物理性質）：外觀、微粒、黏度——這些是最容易偵測到變化的指標
blocks.en: Physical: appearance, particles, viscosity. These are the indicators in which changes are easiest to detect

blocks.zh: Biochemical（生化特性）：聚集體 (Aggregation)、脫醯胺 (Deamidation)、氧化 (Oxidation)、構象 (Conformation)——反映蛋白質分子層級的變化
blocks.en: Biochemical: aggregation, deamidation, oxidation and conformation, which reflect changes at the molecular level of the protein

blocks.zh: Potency/Activity（效力/活性）：最終判斷藥品是否仍能發揮治療效果
blocks.en: Potency/Activity: the ultimate determination of whether the drug product can still deliver its therapeutic effect

blocks.zh: Characterization assays（特性鑑定分析）不需要每批都做，但在建立足夠知識庫之前需定期執行，屬於「瞭解產品」的投資。
blocks.en: Characterization assays do not need to be run on every batch, but must be performed periodically until sufficient knowledge has been built up; they are an investment in "understanding the product".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：矽油的雙重挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Dual Challenge of Silicone Oil

blocks.zh: 矽油不僅可能直接影響藥品品質（如誘導蛋白質聚集），還會嚴重干擾分析方法：
blocks.en: Silicone oil may not only affect drug product quality directly (e.g., by inducing protein aggregation) but also seriously interfere with analytical methods:

blocks.zh: Light obscuration（光遮蔽法）：矽油液滴在儀器中會被計為「微粒」，導致假陽性
blocks.en: Light obscuration: silicone oil droplets are counted as "particles" by the instrument, leading to false positives

blocks.zh: Microflow imaging（微流影像法）：可透過影像辨識區分矽油液滴與蛋白質聚集體，是重要的 orthogonal technique（正交技術）
blocks.en: Microflow imaging: can distinguish silicone oil droplets from protein aggregates through image analysis, and is an important orthogonal technique

blocks.zh: 因此，開發階段就應同時建立光遮蔽法和正交技術的方法，以便正確解讀穩定性試驗中的微粒數據。
blocks.en: Therefore, methods for both light obscuration and an orthogonal technique should be established during the development stage, so that particle data in stability studies can be interpreted correctly.

blocks.zh: 矽油對微粒分析的干擾，就像在聽演唱會時旁邊有人一直大聲說話——你很難分辨歌手的聲音和噪音。Microflow imaging 就像戴上降噪耳機，能幫你濾掉矽油的「噪音」，只聽到真正與蛋白質相關的「信號」。
blocks.en: Interference from silicone oil in particle analysis is like trying to listen to a concert while someone next to you keeps talking loudly: it is hard to tell the singer's voice from the noise. Microflow imaging is like putting on noise-canceling headphones. It filters out the silicone oil "noise" so you hear only the protein-related "signal".

blocks.zh: 重點提示：鎢 (Tungsten) 的隱藏風險
blocks.en: Key Point: The Hidden Risk of Tungsten

blocks.zh: 鎢來自 PFS 製造過程中用來成形針頭通道的鎢針 (tungsten pin)。殘留的鎢離子可導致某些蛋白質聚集或降解。這是選擇 PFS 供應商時必須評估的一個關鍵參數——尤其對鎢敏感的產品，應選擇低鎢或無鎢的 PFS 設計。
blocks.en: Tungsten comes from the tungsten pin used to form the needle channel during PFS manufacturing. Residual tungsten ions can cause some proteins to aggregate or degrade. This is a key parameter to evaluate when selecting a PFS supplier, and for tungsten-sensitive products a low-tungsten or tungsten-free PFS design should be chosen.

blocks.zh: 14.2.2.1 Force Measurements 14.2.2.1 力量量測
blocks.en: 14.2.2.1 Force Measurements

blocks.zh: Force Measurements（力量量測）：包括以下幾個關鍵參數：
blocks.en: Force Measurements: these include the following key parameters:

blocks.zh: Break-loose force（啟動力）：克服膠塞與管壁之間靜摩擦力所需的初始力量
blocks.en: Break-loose force: the initial force needed to overcome the static friction between the stopper and the barrel wall

blocks.zh: Glide force（滑動力）：維持膠塞持續移動所需的力量
blocks.en: Glide force: the force needed to keep the stopper moving

blocks.zh: Extrusion force（擠出力）：將藥液通過針頭推出所需的總力量
blocks.en: Extrusion force: the total force needed to push the drug solution through the needle

blocks.zh: Syringeability（注射器適用性）：是一個綜合指標，考量了藥品黏度、流速、注射力量與針頭規格之間的交互關係。它直接影響患者的使用體驗和劑量遞送的可靠性。
blocks.en: Syringeability: a composite indicator that takes into account the interplay among drug product viscosity, flow rate, injection force and needle gauge. It directly affects the patient experience and the reliability of dose delivery.

blocks.zh: 想像你在使用一支新買的番茄醬瓶——剛打開時需要很大的力量才能擠出第一滴（break-loose force），之後持續擠壓的力量就小一些（glide force），而瓶口的大小決定了醬料流出的阻力（跟 needle gauge 的概念一樣）。如果番茄醬放久了變得更稠（黏度增加），你需要的力量就會更大。這就是為什麼力量量測必須在整個貨架期內持續監測。
blocks.en: Imagine using a new bottle of ketchup: when first opened it takes a lot of force to squeeze out the first drop (break-loose force), after which less force is needed to keep squeezing (glide force), and the size of the opening determines the resistance to flow (the same concept as needle gauge). If the ketchup thickens with age (increased viscosity), you need even more force. This is why force measurements must be monitored throughout the shelf life.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：矽油遷移的長期影響
blocks.en: Key Point: Long-Term Effects of Silicone Oil Migration

blocks.zh: 原文提到 silicone distribution（矽油分布）可能隨時間變化。這是一個實務上非常重要但容易被忽略的問題：
blocks.en: The original text mentions that the silicone distribution may change over time. This is a very important but easily overlooked practical issue:

blocks.zh: 矽油可能從管壁遷移到藥液中，造成潤滑性下降
blocks.en: Silicone oil may migrate from the barrel wall into the drug solution, reducing lubricity

blocks.zh: 潤滑性下降意味著 glide force 增加
blocks.en: Reduced lubricity means an increase in glide force

blocks.zh: 如果力量超過患者或自動注射器能施加的範圍，就會導致注射失敗
blocks.en: If the force exceeds what the patient or autoinjector can apply, the injection will fail

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼穩定性試驗必須包含力量量測的時間點追蹤。
blocks.en: This is why stability studies must include force measurements tracked at each time point.

blocks.zh: 影響注射力量的變數
blocks.en: Variables Affecting Injection Force

blocks.zh:
注射力量 = f(膠塞摩擦力, 藥液黏度, 針頭內徑, 流速)

根據 Hagen-Poiseuille 方程：
  F_needle = (128 x eta x L x Q) / (pi x d^4)

其中：
  eta = 藥液黏度
  L   = 針頭長度
  Q   = 流速 (mL/s)
  d   = 針頭內徑

關鍵啟示：針頭內徑 d 的四次方在分母
  -> 內徑減半，所需力量增加 16 倍！
blocks.en:
Injection force = f(stopper friction, drug solution viscosity, needle inner diameter, flow rate)

According to the Hagen-Poiseuille equation:
  F_needle = (128 x eta x L x Q) / (pi x d^4)

where:
  eta = drug solution viscosity
  L   = needle length
  Q   = flow rate (mL/s)
  d   = needle inner diameter

Key takeaway: the inner diameter d appears to the fourth power in the denominator
  -> halve the inner diameter and the required force increases 16-fold!

blocks.zh: 一位風濕性關節炎患者手部力量有限，如果力量量測發現在貨架期末期 glide force 超過規格，你會建議客戶考慮哪些解決方案？
blocks.en: A patient with rheumatoid arthritis has limited hand strength. If force measurements show that the glide force exceeds the specification at the end of shelf life, what solutions would you suggest the client consider?

blocks.zh: 為什麼力量量測對搭配自動注射器 (autoinjector) 的 PFS 尤其關鍵？
blocks.en: Why are force measurements especially critical for a PFS used with an autoinjector?

blocks.zh: 14.2.2.2 Special Considerations: the Effect of Silicone on Analytical Testing, including Particle Analysis 14.2.2.2 特殊考量：矽油對分析測試（包括微粒分析）之影響
blocks.en: 14.2.2.2 Special Considerations: the Effect of Silicone on Analytical Testing, including Particle Analysis

blocks.zh: Pooling practices（合併取樣）：由於 PFS 通常只有 1 mL 或更少的藥液，但 USP <788> 和歐洲藥典要求至少 25 mL 的測試體積，因此必須將多支 PFS 的內容物合併才能達到測試要求。
blocks.en: Pooling practices: a PFS usually holds only 1 mL or less of drug solution, but USP <788> and the European Pharmacopoeia require a test volume of at least 25 mL, so the contents of multiple PFS must be pooled to meet the test requirement.

blocks.zh: Orthogonal analytical techniques（正交分析技術）：指使用不同原理的分析方法來交叉驗證結果。例如光遮蔽法計數微粒，搭配 microflow imaging 辨識微粒種類（是矽油液滴還是蛋白質聚集體）。
blocks.en: Orthogonal analytical techniques: using analytical methods based on different principles to cross-verify results. For example, light obscuration counts the particles, and microflow imaging identifies the particle type (silicone oil droplet or protein aggregate).

blocks.zh: Sampling method（取樣方法）：從 PFS 取出藥液的方式（從後方倒出 vs 通過針頭注射出）會產生不同量的矽油液滴，因此取樣方法必須標準化並一致使用。
blocks.en: Sampling method: the way the drug solution is removed from the PFS (pouring it out from the back vs. expelling it through the needle) produces different amounts of silicone oil droplets, so the sampling method must be standardized and used consistently.

blocks.zh: 這就像品酒時，不同的倒酒方式（緩慢傾倒 vs 快速灌注）會產生不同量的氣泡。如果你每次用不同方式倒酒，就無法公平比較不同瓶酒的清澈度。同理，PFS 的取樣方法必須固定，否則矽油液滴的數量會因操作差異而波動，導致數據無法比較。
blocks.en: It is like wine tasting: different ways of pouring (slow decanting vs. fast pouring) produce different amounts of bubbles. If you pour differently each time, you cannot fairly compare the clarity of different bottles. Likewise, the PFS sampling method must be fixed. Otherwise the number of silicone oil droplets will fluctuate with operator differences and the data cannot be compared.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：小體積微粒測試的挑戰
blocks.en: Key Point: The Challenge of Small-Volume Particle Testing

blocks.zh: USP <788> 的 25 mL 體積要求是為大容量注射劑設計的。對於 PFS（通常 0.5-1 mL），這帶來了獨特挑戰：
blocks.en: The 25 mL volume requirement in USP <788> was designed for large-volume injectables. For a PFS (typically 0.5-1 mL), this creates unique challenges:

blocks.zh: 合併 25-50 支 PFS 才能湊夠測試體積——合併過程本身可能引入微粒
blocks.en: 25-50 PFS must be pooled to reach the test volume, and the pooling process itself may introduce particles

blocks.zh: 小體積光遮蔽法 (small-volume LO) 是替代方案，但必須針對特定藥品進行確效 (qualification & validation)
blocks.en: Small-volume light obscuration (small-volume LO) is an alternative, but it must be qualified and validated for the specific drug product

blocks.zh: 脫氣 (degassing) 和稀釋 (dilution) 可能是必要的前處理步驟，以獲得一致的結果
blocks.en: Degassing and dilution may be necessary pre-treatment steps to obtain consistent results

blocks.zh: 法規機構對微粒管控越來越嚴格（參考文獻 82, 108），這是穩定性試驗中不可忽視的領域。
blocks.en: Regulators are increasingly strict about particulate control (see references 82 and 108), so this is an area of stability testing that cannot be ignored.

blocks.zh: 你負責建立一個 PFS 微粒測試方法。你會如何設計取樣 SOP 以確保數據的可比較性？需要考慮哪些變數？
blocks.en: You are responsible for establishing a particle testing method for a PFS. How would you design the sampling SOP to ensure the data are comparable? Which variables need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文強調在「開發階段」就應建立光遮蔽法和正交技術？如果到商業化階段才開始，會有什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why does the original text stress establishing light obscuration and orthogonal techniques during the "development stage"? What problems would arise if you only started at the commercialization stage?

blocks.zh: 14.3 Compatibility of the Drug Product with the Plunger Stopper and Needle Shield 14.3 藥品與推桿塞及針頭護套之相容性
blocks.en: 14.3 Compatibility of the Drug Product with the Plunger Stopper and Needle Shield

blocks.zh: Plunger Stopper（活塞膠塞）：位於注射器內部，與藥液直接接觸，負責密封和推送藥液。常見材質為溴化丁基橡膠 (bromobutyl rubber)，表面可能塗有矽油或含氟聚合物塗層。
blocks.en: Plunger Stopper: located inside the syringe and in direct contact with the drug solution, it seals the syringe and pushes the solution out. It is commonly made of bromobutyl rubber, and its surface may be coated with silicone oil or a fluoropolymer coating.

blocks.zh: Needle Shield（護針蓋/針頭保護蓋）：覆蓋在固定式針頭 (staked needle) 外部的橡膠蓋。藥液可能透過針頭尖端與護針蓋內表面接觸，尤其在長期儲存時。
blocks.en: Needle Shield: the rubber cap covering the staked needle. The drug solution may come into contact with the inner surface of the needle shield through the needle tip, especially during long-term storage.

blocks.zh: Higher-order aggregates（高階聚集體）：蛋白質分子的多重結合體，可能具有免疫原性，是生物製劑安全性的重大隱憂。
blocks.en: Higher-order aggregates: multiple associations of protein molecules that may be immunogenic and are a major safety concern for biologics.

blocks.zh: 護針蓋的問題就像瓶蓋的軟木塞——紅酒的瓶口處僅有少量液體與軟木塞接觸，但長時間下來這個小接觸面就可能導致「木塞味」污染整瓶酒。同理，PFS 的針頭尖端僅有微量藥液與護針蓋接觸，但由於表面積與體積比 (surface area to volume ratio)極高，這個微小區域的相互作用被放大了，可能導致針頭處的蛋白質聚集甚至堵塞。
blocks.en: The needle shield problem is like the cork in a wine bottle: only a small amount of wine at the neck touches the cork, but over a long time this small contact area can cause "cork taint" in the whole bottle. Similarly, only a tiny amount of drug solution at the PFS needle tip contacts the needle shield, but because of the very high surface area to volume ratio, the interaction in this small area is magnified and can lead to protein aggregation, or even clogging, at the needle.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：針頭堵塞的連鎖效應
blocks.en: Key Point: The Chain Reaction of Needle Clogging

blocks.zh: 原文描述了一個令人擔憂的連鎖反應：
blocks.en: The original text describes a worrying chain reaction:

blocks.zh: 藥品與護針蓋不相容 → 蛋白質在針頭尖端聚集 (polymer formation)
blocks.en: Drug product incompatible with the needle shield → protein aggregates at the needle tip (polymer formation)

blocks.zh: 聚集體堵塞針頭 → 注射阻力增加 (higher forces required)
blocks.en: Aggregates clog the needle → greater injection resistance (higher forces required)

blocks.zh: 力量增加 → 患者（尤其是手部活動受限者）無法完成注射，可能導致劑量不足
blocks.en: Increased force → the patient (especially one with limited hand mobility) cannot complete the injection, which may result in under-dosing

blocks.zh: 注入高階聚集體 → 可能觸發免疫反應 (immunogenicity)
blocks.en: Injection of higher-order aggregates → may trigger an immune response (immunogenicity)

blocks.zh: 這是一個從「包材相容性」直接影響到「患者安全」的典型案例，充分說明為什麼相容性測試如此重要。
blocks.en: This is a typical case in which "packaging compatibility" directly affects "patient safety", and it shows clearly why compatibility testing is so important.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：膠塞浸出物的金屬風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Metal Risk from Stopper Leachables

blocks.zh: 膠塞配方中可能含有金屬催化劑（如鋅化合物），這些金屬可在長期接觸中浸出到藥液中。某些金屬離子會：
blocks.en: Stopper formulations may contain metal catalysts (such as zinc compounds), and these metals can leach into the drug solution during long-term contact. Certain metal ions will:

blocks.zh: 催化蛋白質氧化反應
blocks.en: Catalyze protein oxidation reactions

blocks.zh: 促進聚集體形成
blocks.en: Promote aggregate formation

blocks.zh: 降低藥品效力
blocks.en: Reduce drug potency

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 E&L（Extractables & Leachables，可萃取物與浸出物）評估對膠塞和護針蓋都很重要，參見 Section 5 的詳細討論。
blocks.en: This is why E&L (Extractables & Leachables) assessment is important for both the stopper and the needle shield; see the detailed discussion in Section 5.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，當你在為客戶評估 PFS 組件時，護針蓋的相容性測試往往被低估。建議在穩定性方案中特別加入以下設計：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when evaluating PFS components for a client, needle shield compatibility testing is often underestimated. It is advisable to add the following design to the stability program:

blocks.zh: 將 PFS 以針頭朝下的方式儲存一組樣品，使藥液與護針蓋持續接觸
blocks.en: Store one set of samples with the needle pointing down, so that the drug solution stays in continuous contact with the needle shield

blocks.zh: 在關鍵時間點（如 T=0, 3M, 6M, 12M）取樣檢測針頭尖端的微粒和聚集體
blocks.en: Sample at key time points (e.g., T=0, 3M, 6M, 12M) to test for particles and aggregates at the needle tip

blocks.zh: 同時進行護針蓋材料的 E&L 研究，建立完整的相容性資料
blocks.en: Conduct an E&L study on the needle shield material at the same time, to build a complete compatibility data package

blocks.zh: 原文提到「product solution may or may not come into contact with the needle shield」。在什麼條件下藥液會與護針蓋接觸？儲存方向會有影響嗎？
blocks.en: The original text states that "product solution may or may not come into contact with the needle shield". Under what conditions does the drug solution contact the needle shield? Does storage orientation have an effect?

blocks.zh: 如果你的客戶報告在穩定性試驗中發現注射力量隨時間顯著增加，你會建議從哪些方面著手調查？
blocks.en: If your client reports that the injection force increased significantly over time in the stability study, which areas would you recommend investigating?

blocks.zh: 膠塞上的矽油可能是交聯型 (cross-linked) 也可能是非交聯型。兩者對藥品的影響有何不同？哪種風險較高？
blocks.en: Silicone oil on the stopper may be cross-linked or non-cross-linked. How do the two differ in their effect on the drug product, and which carries the higher risk?
